units.source_text: 不过，大公主似乎还沉浸在被救的喜悦中，并未听到这个声音。

en.t: However, the eldest princess still seemed immersed in the joy of having been rescued, and did not hear the voice.

units.source_text: 过了片刻，她忽然满怀心事的对发长彦说：“虽然我有幸被你救了，但是我的妹妹还不知所踪。”

en.t: After a moment, she suddenly said to Kaminagahiko with a troubled heart, "Although I was fortunate enough to be saved by you, my younger sister is still nowhere to be found."
